title: Eggplanty Oozy Moroccan Paprika Stew
description: This hearty stew is perfect for those lazy Sunday mornings, featuring eggplants, en-croute, and a touch of peppercorns to create a yeasty, chewy dish that feels like a sick-day comfort food.

ingredients.name: 2 cups low-sodium chicken or vegetable broth

instructions: Cut eggplants into cubes and place in a single layer on a baking sheet.
In another pan, sauté onion until soft and translucent. Add garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add eggplant cubes to the pan with onions and sauté together for 10 minutes.
Stir in en-croute bread cubes and tomato paste, mixing well to combine.
Pour in chicken or vegetable broth, add lemon juice, and stir to mix evenly. Bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low, cover pan with lid, and bake in the oven for 30 minutes.
Serve hot as a side dish or over rice.
